evidence.note: Schofield lists Hippias Major among the major extended authenticity problems on which opinion remains divided.
SEP surveys arguments on both sides and concludes that the authenticity case must be left not proven.

rationale: Hippias Major remains an unresolved authenticity case. Serious scholars defend Platonic authorship while others reject it, and the Stanford Encyclopedia explicitly concludes that the case is not proven. B therefore preserves the live scholarly dispute.
